correctness.rationale: The centrally symmetric support is max_i g_i−min_i g_i for the full root polytope, and max_{different labels}|g_i−g_j| for multipartite. Positive loss D>s is exactly the event that the extreme upper/lower caps of radius s all have the same color. Uniform random rank labeling gives conditional probability Σ_c(n_c)_{K_s}/(N)_{K_s}. Outward integer part-size transfer changes the k falling factorial terms by k![C(p,k−1)−C(q−1,k−1)]≥0, strict for k=2 and attainable at every finite Gaussian s. Rotational Gaussian normalization gives spherical stochastic order and strict mean-width extremizers. Independent marked upper/lower Gaussian Poisson point-process limits give survival Σ α_c²/[α_c+(1−α_c)e^t]², positive-proportion uniform integrability via bounded second moments of rescaled Gaussian extrema, and mean −1−Σlog(1−α_c). Strict convexity of x²/[x+(1−x)e^t]² proves Schur majorization of limiting law. Independent exact rank-allocation enumeration for 20 small cases plus symbolic convexity identity corroborated finite claims; no finite experiment substitutes for the Poisson proof.

originality.rationale: D'Alì–Delucchi–Michałek (2022) define and relate symmetric edge, adjacency, and Kantorovich–Rubinstein polytopes and analyze algebraic, facet, and Ehrhart invariants; Higashitani–Jochemko–Michałek (2019) derive facet/Ehrhart results for complete bipartite/multipartite shapes. The exact two-part directional-width result is an acknowledged COVERED SPECIAL CASE and not independently original. The r≥3 finite exact conditional cap law, complete majorization of loss for every threshold, and multicolor independent upper/lower Poisson law are not supplied by the inspected primary theorem sections and not an algebraic consequence of the facet h* count. A general Gaussian colored-order-statistics paper could carry an equivalent formulation, residual risk retained.
